kind: product integration checks; no autonomous qualification

checks.browser_policy: play initializes under an enforced script-src self + wasm-unsafe-eval policy; no JavaScript unsafe-eval exception
checks.controls: assisted/direct keyboard actions, release, pause, blur freeze, deterministic reset, pagehide pause and replay terminal checked

desktop_timing_screen.environment: T3 collaborative Chromium on the development host, 1280x900; local static server

limits: Selected short fixed fixtures do not establish full-campaign equivalence across MuJoCo versions.

Physical phone and emulator performance remain unverified; the narrow browser viewport is responsive-layout evidence only.
No human win-rate study, unseen-serve reliability, learned-controller improvement or ranked result is claimed.
